# Sangamlung Gangmei

> Sangamlung Gangmei is a computer science engineer, AI and automation expert and WhatsApp Cloud API expert based in Dimapur, Nagaland, India. Builds AI integrations, workflow automation and web applications for businesses as a freelancer, and has published peer-reviewed IEEE research on AI traffic-violation detection.

The site at https://etukwaru.online/ is an interactive dumping ground: a garbage truck unloads the projects, and billboards along the road describe each one. Everything on it is summarised here.

## Research

- [Modular AI-Based Framework for Two-Wheeler Traffic Violation Detection Using Object Detection, Pose Estimation, and ALPR](https://doi.org/10.1109/ICC-CNS70518.2026.11606049): IEEE, ICC-CNS 2026. TrafficVision watches roadside video for riders without helmets and for triple riding, reads number plates (0.995 mAP@0.5) and emails the registered owner an e-challan. Team: Dr. Bondita Paul, Simanta Hazarika, Deep Das, Vikosalie Chusi, Marcel Basumatary, Chiranjeet Borah. [Code](https://github.com/syberPawn/Traffic_VISION_demo)

## Work

- [Makaam Sports Enterprises](https://makaamsports.com/): ZenZen, an AI receptionist on the website of a sports infrastructure company in Dimapur. Answers visitors around the clock from the company's own information, collects leads into a sheet and emails the owner a summary of each conversation. Also the company website.
- Event Management Software: WhatsApp Cloud API automation for an international event company. Personalised invitations through the WhatsApp Business Platform, with replies recorded automatically and live counts for several events at once.
- [Dgtal Register](https://www.dgtalregister.xyz/): an offline-first attendance app for teachers.
- [Higher or Lower: Nagaland](https://higherlower.etukwaru.online): a guessing game about Nagaland and the Naga people.
- [Scholarship Hunting](https://scholarship.etukwaru.online): a pixel-art browser game and political satire.
